summary_text: Bernstein initiated coverage Monday with Outperform and $300 PT, sparking gains. Major banks pushed ARM PTs into $250-$300 range. Q4 FY26 revenue $1.49B (+20% YoY), highest quarterly ever; licensing +29% to $819M. Market cap surpassed $300B. CEO Rene Haas disclosed AGI CPU committed customer demand exceeds $2B across FY27-FY28, more than double the $1B figure at launch six weeks earlier. FTC initiated antitrust investigation into ARM's semiconductor licensing practices. Stock jumped 16.16% to $298.23, with $312 as next resistance.
